# Online Criminal Record Check (criminalrecordcheckonline.com)

> Run by Surrey Fingerprint Company, Surrey, BC, which is accredited by the RCMP for fingerprinting. Name-based CPIC and CRJMC criminal record checks can be requested online from anywhere in Canada. This is a private business website, not an official RCMP or Government of Canada website.

## Facts
- Business: Surrey Fingerprint Company, 112-8232 120 St, Surrey, BC V3W 3N4
- Phone: 604-825-0177. Email: info@surreyfingerprint.com
- CPIC name-based check: $45 CAD. CRJMC check: $50 CAD
- Online applications are completed on a screening partner's website (everify.reliabilityscreening.ca)
- Fingerprinting (digital and ink-and-roll) is done in person in Surrey, BC
- Service focus: British Columbia, Ontario, Alberta, Manitoba; online applications open across Canada
